channels.title: One agent across every channel your customers already use

problem.label: The problem
problem.intro: Every message that sits unanswered is a customer who moved on to whoever picked up first. It never shows up as a lost sale — it just looks like a slow week.
problem.c1Text: Your best window is the minute someone is interested, and that minute ignores business hours. By Monday they’ve already booked with someone else.
problem.c2Text: Website chat, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Messenger. Nothing is connected, and the serious buyer is buried under people asking for your address.
problem.c3Text: Hours, pricing, availability, service area, do you take card. Your team retypes the same answers instead of closing the people ready to buy.

product.label: The product
product.intro: Your agent doesn’t just reply. It figures out what the person actually wants, scores them, and puts the ones worth your time at the top.
product.f1Text: Budget, timing, service needed, location. The agent asks before you spend a minute on the call.
product.f2Text: A WhatsApp message and a website chat land in the same inbox, with the same context attached.
product.f3Text: When a human is needed, your team picks up mid-conversation instead of asking the customer to repeat themselves.
product.f4Text: The questions piling up in your inbox are a marketing brief. The dashboard shows you the pattern.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps. No developer.
how.intro: You describe the business, set the rules, and paste one line of code. Most owners are live the same afternoon.
how.s1Text: Hours, services, pricing, service area, the questions you answer all day. Point it at your website and it takes the rest from there.
how.s2Text: What it’s allowed to say, what it must ask before a lead counts as qualified, and exactly when it hands the conversation to a person.
how.s3Text: Drop the widget on your site and connect WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram. One agent, the same answers, every channel.

caps.label: Capabilities
caps.title: What it handles without you
caps.intro: Six things it does on its own, every day, without anyone on your team stepping in.
caps.c1Title: Answers in seconds, around the clock
caps.c1Text: Hours, pricing, availability, service area, how it works — answered at 3pm or 3am, in English or Spanish.
caps.c2Text: It asks the qualifying questions your team would ask, then scores and routes the lead so nobody wastes a call.
caps.c3Text: Name, number, reason for the call, preferred time — collected in the conversation, not in a follow-up email thread.
caps.c4Title: Hands off cleanly to a person
caps.c4Text: When it reaches the edge of what it knows, or the customer asks for a human, it transfers with the whole thread attached.
caps.c5Text: Who’s contacting you, from which channel, and what they keep asking about — so you know what to fix on the website.
caps.c6Text: Trained only on what you give it. When it doesn’t know, it says so and escalates instead of inventing an answer.

start.cardText: Sign up, describe your business, and your agent is live the same afternoon. No developer needed.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Straight answers
faq.leadPost: — we’ll tell you if it isn’t a fit.
faq.q1: Can I try it before I pay?
faq.a1: Yes. The free plan isn’t a countdown — run a real agent on your website for as long as you want. Upgrade when the leads it captures are worth more than $29 a month.
faq.q2: Will it make my business feel robotic?
faq.a2: It answers the way you tell it to. Most of what it handles is the routine layer — hours, pricing, availability — that your team already answers with copy-paste. The moment it becomes a real conversation, it hands off to a person with the full thread.
faq.q3: What if it tells a customer something wrong?
faq.a3: It only knows what you give it and is configured to stay inside those boundaries. Outside its knowledge, it’s built to say so and escalate rather than guess. You can read every conversation and correct the source any time.
faq.q4: Is my business too small for this?
faq.a4: Small teams get more out of it, not less. If you’re one or two people, this is the difference between answering at 11pm and losing the job. Start on the free plan — the only cost is the setup time.
faq.a5: Under an hour for most businesses. Create the account, describe what you do, paste one line of code on your site. Each channel takes a few more minutes to connect. No developer, no integration project.
faq.q6: What happens to my customers’ data?
faq.a6: Encrypted in transit and at rest. We never store payment card details. Your conversations are yours — not sold, and not used to train models for anyone else.
faq.q7: Will my customers know it’s an AI?
faq.a7: That’s your call, and we recommend transparency — it costs nothing and builds trust. What customers actually care about is getting an answer now instead of tomorrow.
